lesson_quiz.question: Theo bai doc, hau qua truc tiep cua viec thiet lap sai lech logic khi so sanh so du tai khoan voi so tien can rut la gi?
options: He thong tu dong nang han muc tin dung cho doanh nghiep.
Doanh nghiep doi mat voi nguy co that thoat tai chinh nghiem trong.
Toan bo he thong giao dich bi khoa tam thoi.
Giao dich luon thanh cong ma khong phu thuoc vao nguon tien.
lesson_quiz.explanation: Bai doc chi ro rang: 'Neu thiet lap logic sai lech trong cac phep so sanh so du tai khoan voi so tien rut, doanh nghiep co nguy co doi mat voi that thoat tai chinh nghiem trong.'

lesson_quiz.question: Toan tu so sanh nao khong duoc ke ten truc tiep tren hinh anh so do khoi cua logic so sanh trong bai doc?
lesson_quiz.explanation: Hinh anh so do khoi chi ra ro cac toan tu (>=, <=, ==). Toan tu khac biet != (khac) khong xuat hien truc tiep tai do.

lesson_quiz.question: Dieu gi xay ra neu logic so sanh cua he thong qua cung nhac hoac xu ly sai lech kieu du lieu?
options: Khach hang hop le bi tu choi, lam xau trai nghiem nguoi dung.
Tai khoan tu dong chuyen sang trang thai uu tien.
He thong tu dong chuyen doi tat ca chuoi ky tu thanh du lieu logic.
Nhan vien ky thuat phai can thiep thu cong vao moi lenh rut.
lesson_quiz.explanation: Doan van neu ro: 'Nguoc lai, neu logic so sanh qua cung nhac hoac xu ley sai lech kieu du lieu, cac khach hang hop le se bi tu choi, gay giam trai nghiem nguoi dung.'

lesson_quiz.question: Trong Python, cac toan tu so sanh co vai tro gi trong bo may xu ly giao dich cua ung dung doanh nghiep?
options: Xac thuc cau truc co so du lieu truoc khi cai dat.
Là cong cu cot loi lam can cu dua ra cac quyet dinh logic o thoi diem thuc thi.
Tang toc do ket noi internet cho he thong thanh toan.
Tu dong ma hoa mat khau cua tai khoan nguoi dung.
lesson_quiz.explanation: Viet theo dung thong tin bai doc: 'Python su dung cac toan tu so sanh lam cong cu cot loi de dua ra cac quyet dinh logic nay tai thoi diem thuc thi chuong trinh.'

practical_lab.title: Xay dung module kiem check han muc rut tien chu dong
objectives: Ap dung dung cac toan tu so sanh de lam bo loc dau vao cho transaction.
Kiem soat chat che logic dieu kien de tranh viec tai khoan bi am tien.
In ra chinh xac trang thai logic cua giao dich theo tieu chi yeu cau.

description.inputs: Dự án/môi trường phát triển python/core hiện tại và tài nguyên khóa học.
steps: Buoc 1: Khai bao bien 'balance' bieu thi so du hien co va bien 'amount' bieu thi so tien muon rut.
Buoc 2: Su dung cau truc re nhanh va toan tu >= de so sanh balance voi amount.
Buoc 3: Neu balance >= amount, in ra dong thong bao hop le: 'Giao dich thanh cong'.
Buoc 4: Trong truong hop nguoc lai (khi so du nho hon so tien rut), in ra: 'Huy giao dich: So du khong du'.

checklist: Logic so sanh phai chac chan loai tru cac truong hop balance nho hon amount.
Chuong trinh khong gap loi ve kieu khi so sanh (dam bao ca hai deu la kieu so).
Du lieu output khop dung voi cac gia thiet logic logic dau vao thiet lap.
